function.name: get_metrics
function.description: Return metrics for a service within an optional time range, optionally filtered to specific metric names.

services.description: The service names to fetch metrics for.

start_time.description: Optional start of the time range in ISO-8601 format.

end_time.description: Optional end of the time range in ISO-8601 format.

metric_names.description: Optional list of metric names to include in the results.

function.name: search_logs
function.description: Search logs for a service within an optional time range, optionally filtered by log level.

services.description: The service names whose logs should be searched.

start_time.description: Optional start of the time range in ISO-8601 format.

end_time.description: Optional end of the time range in ISO-8601 format.

level.description: Optional log level such as INFO, WARN, or ERROR.

function.name: get_recent_deployments
function.description: Return deployments for a service within an optional time range.

services.description: The service names to retrieve deployments for.

start_time.description: Optional start of the deployment time range in ISO-8601 format.

end_time.description: Optional end of the deployment time range in ISO-8601 format.

function.name: get_recent_pull_requests
function.description: Return pull requests merged within an optional time range for a service.

services.description: The service names whose merged pull requests should be retrieved.

start_time.description: Optional start of the pull request merged time range in ISO-8601 format.

end_time.description: Optional end of the pull request merged time range in ISO-8601 format.

function.name: get_pull_request
function.description: Return a specific pull request by its pull request number.

number.description: The pull request number to retrieve.

function.name: get_code_owners_for_path
function.description: Find the code owners responsible for a given repository file path. Optionally filter by one or more services when the same path may exist across multiple services.

file_path.description: The repository file path to find code owners for.

services.description: Optional list of services to restrict the search to.
